title: Dual-Stream Multiple Instance Learning Network for Whole Slide Image Classification With Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning
method: Dual-stream MIL with contrastive patch representations.
main_findings: DSMIL combines instance scoring and relation-based bag aggregation.
limitations: Tumor benchmarks; no cardiac rejection validation.
Review covers the cited pages; quantitative tables require further source verification.
does_not_establish: No demonstrated advantage on SMC rejection.
